```artifact
Feature: Admin and User Functionalities

  @VIRTUA-2.3-5
  Scenario Outline: Admin edits labs/pharmacy details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin updates the <field> to <value>
    Then the <field> should be updated to <value>
    Examples:
      | field        | value          |
      | lab_name     | New Lab Name   |
      | pharmacy_name| New Pharmacy   |
      | lab_name     |                | # Edge case: empty value
      | pharmacy_name|                | # Edge case: empty value

  @VIRTUA-2.3-5
  Scenario Outline: Admin deletes labs/pharmacy details
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin deletes the <entity>
    Then the <entity> should no longer exist
    Examples:
      | entity        |
      | lab           |
      | pharmacy      |

  @VIRTUA-2.3-6
  Scenario Outline: Patient registers
    Given the patient is on the registration page
    When the patient enters <name> and <email>
    Then the patient should be registered with name <name> and email <email>
    Examples:
      | name          | email                  |
      | John Doe      | john.doe@example.com   |
      | Jane Smith    | jane.smith@example.com |
      | John Doe      |                        | # Edge case: empty email
      |               | jane.smith@example.com | # Edge case: empty name

  @VIRTUA-2.3-7
  Scenario Outline: Patient updates profile
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient updates the <field> to <value>
    Then the <field> should be updated to <value>
    Examples:
      | field        | value          |
      | name         | New Name       |
      | email        | new.email@example.com |
      | name         |                | # Edge case: empty value
      | email        |                | # Edge case: empty value

  @VIRTUA-2.3-8
  Scenario Outline: Patient makes appointments and submits online consultation requests
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient makes an appointment with <doctor> at <time>
    Then the appointment should be scheduled with <doctor> at <time>
    Examples:
      | doctor        | time           |
      | Dr. Smith     | 10:00 AM       |
      | Dr. Johnson   | 2:00 PM        |
      | Dr. Smith     |                | # Edge case: empty time
      |               | 10:00 AM       | # Edge case: empty doctor

  @VIRTUA-2.3-9
  Scenario Outline: Patient views and generates prescription reports and invoices
    Given the patient is logged in
    When the patient views the <document>
    Then the <document> should be displayed
    Examples:
      | document      |
      | prescription  |
      | invoice       |

  @VIRTUA-2.3-10
  Scenario Outline: Doctor provides consultation
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor provides consultation to <patient>
    Then the consultation should be recorded for <patient>
    Examples:
      | patient       |
      | John Doe      |
      | Jane Smith    |

  @VIRTUA-2.3-11
  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes medicine
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor prescribes <medicine> to <patient>
    Then the prescription for <medicine> should be recorded for <patient>
    Examples:
      | medicine      | patient        |
      | Aspirin       | John Doe       |
      | Ibuprofen     | Jane Smith     |
      | Aspirin       |                | # Edge case: empty patient
      |               | John Doe       | # Edge case: empty medicine

  @VIRTUA-2.3-12
  Scenario Outline: Doctor prescribes lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor prescribes <test> to <patient>
    Then the lab test <test> should be recorded for <patient>
    Examples:
      | test          | patient        |
      | Blood Test    | John Doe       |
      | Urine Test    | Jane Smith     |
      | Blood Test    |                | # Edge case: empty patient
      |               | John Doe       | # Edge case: empty test
```
